description: Defines the 'Coocook::Schema::Result::Item' class representing a database table for purchase list items, including columns, relationships, and methods for unit conversion and updating from ingredients.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Item
classes.description: Represents an item in a purchase list, with properties such as value, unit, article, and methods for unit conversion and updating based on ingredients.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts the item's unit to another unit, updating the item and related entries accordingly.

methods.name: update_from_ingredients
methods.description: Updates the item's value based on its associated ingredients, converting units if necessary.
